prep.summary: You reviewed the go/techvmo process during your last sync with Jon on August 11—specifically focusing on aligning contract-associated architecture decisions directly with the Deal Review phase using tailored evidence packets. This strategic shift eliminates redundant final spend approvals—saving critical cycle time—unless cost-related or architectural changes emerge later. For non-contract decisions like the ATM-as-a-Service model—you established a streamlined Tech Fellow approval bypass to skip formal deal reviews entirely.
tasks: Cross-reference active architecture reviews against the Tech Spend dashboard to identify missing or unaligned spend items.
Build the required evidence packets demonstrating platform strategy fit and capability coverage for upcoming contract-associated decisions.
Route non-contract and informational decisions through the newly defined Tech Fellow approval workflow to bypass formal deal reviews.
Track the pipeline of specific vendor initiatives—including Cognizant, MSV, and task mining—to ensure early architecture alignment.
